assignment.title: A small act of kindness
assignment.topic: Describe a time when you helped someone. Explain what happened and what you learned.
assignment.modelEssay:
Last Friday, I saw a new classmate standing alone. I asked him to join our group.

We worked together on a poster. I explained our plan and listened to his ideas. Soon, he began to smile.

I learned that a small act of kindness can make a big difference.
